caseNameFull: Penn-Dixie Cement Corp. v. Dickinson, Commissioner of Finance and Taxation
attorneys: Charles C. Moore for appellant., Roy H. Beeler, Attorney General of Tennessee, and Allison B. Humphreys, Solicitor General, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:
